summary: Russia launched a massive overnight missile strike involving 32 Kh-101 missiles from Tu-95MS bombers and up to 12 from Tu-160s, plus Kalibr cruise missiles, hitting Fire Point defense facilities across seven Ukrainian regions including Kyiv, Chernihiv, Poltava, Kirovohrad, Dnipropetrovsk, and Kharkiv. Ukrainian forces destroyed a rare Russian Buk-M3 reload vehicle (TZS) near the Chongar bridge linking occupied Crimea and Kherson region. Russian "Vostok" group troops liberated the village of Golubkovo in Zaporizhzhia region.
key_points: Russia fired 32 Kh-101 from Tu-95MS and up to 12 from Tu-160 plus Kalibr missiles overnight, striking Fire Point facilities in Kyiv, Chernihiv, Kirovohrad, Dnipropetrovsk, Poltava, and Kharkiv regions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76169, @mon1tor_ua/76166, @ukr_leaks_eng/33791)
Ukrainian forces destroyed a Russian Buk-M3 reload vehicle (TZS) transporting missiles near the Chongar bridge, the first confirmed kill of this system. (Source: @UkraineNow/84524)
Russian "Vostok" group liberated Golubkovo village in Zaporizhzhia region. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33766)
Chongar bridge span collapsed between Crimea and Kherson, disrupting Russian military logistics. (Source: @UkraineNow/84510)
Russian air defense claimed 311 Ukrainian UAVs shot down over Russian regions overnight. (Source: @tass_agency/399130)
Poland will deploy Patriot batteries near Lublin airport close to the Ukrainian border. (Source: @UkraineNow/84515)

Jet-powered drones (reactive UAVs) detected across northern, central, and southern Ukraine at 500-600 km/h; Ukrainian Air Force predicts speed increase to 800-900 km/h. (Source: @kpszsu/83525, @ukr_leaks_eng/33784)
South Korea considers recalling its ambassador to Ukraine over dissatisfaction with apology regarding North Korean prisoners. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33765)

points: Ukrainian forces destroyed a Russian Buk-M3 reload vehicle (TZS) transporting a missile loadout near the Chongar bridge between occupied Crimea and Kherson region, marking the first confirmed kill of this rare system. (Source: @UkraineNow/84524)
The SBU, with FBI assistance, detained the founder of a Telegram channel in Kyiv for inciting terrorist acts and providing instructions for manufacturing explosives. (Source: @UkraineNow/84512)

The Verkhovna Rada will consider a bill expanding Hungarian and other EU language rights in education, a move linked to opening two new EU accession negotiation clusters for Ukraine. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33782)
Ukrainian air defense engaged a massive Russian missile strike overnight; at one point 17 cruise missiles were simultaneously tracked in Ukrainian airspace. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76190)
In Volyn region, military personnel were filmed transporting a downed drone through a city. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33772)

Russian Aerospace Forces launched a massive overnight strike: 32 Kh-101 missiles from Tu-95MS bombers and up to 12 from Tu-160s, supplemented by Kalibr naval missiles, targeting Fire Point missile and drone production facilities across seven Ukrainian regions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76169, @mon1tor_ua/76166, @ukr_leaks_eng/33791)
Russian "Vostok" group of troops liberated the village of Golubkovo in Zaporizhzhia region. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33766)
Russian air defense systems destroyed 311 Ukrainian UAVs over Russian regions overnight, according to the Ministry of Defense. (Source: @tass_agency/399130)
United Aircraft Corporation delivered a new batch of Su-34 fighter-bombers to the Russian Ministry of Defense. (Source: @tass_agency/399129)
North Korean leader Kim Jong Un reaffirmed unwavering support for Russia in a birthday telegram to President Putin. (Source: @tass_agency/399100)
Russian "Vostok" group liberated Golubkovo village in Zaporizhzhia region, advancing on the eastern front. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33766)

Russian missile strikes hit Dnipropetrovsk region: up to 3 Kalibr missiles targeted Dnipro city; a jet-powered UAV was observed in western Dnipropetrovsk heading east. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76166, @kpszsu/83491)

Kharkiv region was targeted by Russian missiles as part of the massive strike; Kh-101 hits reported in Kharkiv region and a UAV detected approaching Kharkiv from the north. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33791, @kpszsu/83495)
Fire Point facilities in Dnipropetrovsk and Kharkiv regions were struck during the overnight missile campaign. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33791)

Russian jet-powered UAVs penetrated Chernihiv region along the Belarus border heading toward Kyiv region; multiple reactive UAVs detected in western and northern Chernihiv. (Source: @kpszsu/83522, @kpszsu/83495, @eRadarrua/120612)

Massive Kh-101 strikes on Chernihiv region: 4 missiles on Pryluky, 3 from Poltava to Pryluky district, 3 more on Pryluky; strikes also reported on Oster and Berezna. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76203, @mon1tor_ua/76200, @mon1tor_ua/76198, @eRadarrua/120612)

Kyiv region under sustained drone and missile threat: 3 cruise missiles from Chernihiv to Boryspil district; reactive UAVs heading to Fastiv and Kyiv; air alert declared with drone threat at yellow level. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76194, @kpszsu/83524, @kpszsu/83495, @eRadarrua/120620, @eRadarrua/120619)
Sumy region reported 3 groups of strike UAVs operating in the area. (Source: @eRadarrua/120567)

Russian reactive UAVs active across southern Ukraine: multiple jet drones in Mykolaiv region heading north toward Kirovohrad; UAVs detected in Odesa region at Pivdenne and Krasnosilka; eastern Odesa UAV moving northwest. (Source: @kpszsu/83519, @kpszsu
